pages.title: Ghost of a Vein
pages.text: A helper finds the chosen ore instead of random tunnelling.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Drop the desired ore block nearby; ghost mining reveals ore positions. Its rare pickaxe buffers mined items when inventory is full and repairs with membranes; the pickaxe drop is not required here.
